title: Efficacy of an empirical treatment with Amoxicillin-clavulanate (AC) compared to the combination Amoxicillin-clavulanate and Ciprofloxacin (AC+C) in the outpatient care of chemotherapy-induced fever in adult haematology patients. AC-CIF Protocol
official: Efficacy of an empirical treatment with Amoxicillin-clavulanate (AC) compared to the combination Amoxicillin-clavulanate and Ciprofloxacin (AC+C) in the outpatient care of chemotherapy-induced fever in adult haematology patients. AC-CIF Protocol
summary: Main objective: To demonstrate the non-inferiority of amoxicillin-clavulanate (AC) compared to the reference combination treatment amoxicillin-clavulanate and ciprofloxacin (AC+C), in the empirical oral outpatient treatment of a first episode of CIF in adult haematology patients.
conditions: Adult patients treated for haematological disorders, in whom chemotherapy regimens are expected to induce neutropenia lasting <7 days
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. •	Adult patients (≥ 18 years) with one of the following haematological disorders (in whom chemotherapy regimens are expected to provoke neutropenia lasting <7 days) (1) lymphoma of all histological types treated with the goal of remission;  (2) myelodysplasia treated with azacytidine;   (3) acute myeloblastic leukaemia, treated with a non-intensive scheme (azacytidine, azacytidine+venetoclax, other oral treatment against molecular targets)
2. •	Written informed consent
3. •	Affiliated to or beneficiary of the welfare care
4. •	Patient able to understand all information related to the study and able to follow the protocol procedures (phone call and completion of the patient follow-up form (electronic or paper))
Exclusion criteria:
1. Patient under legal protection
2. Previous treatment with CAR-T cells
3. Previous allogeneic or autogeneic bone-marrow transplantation
4. Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD)
5. Previous invasive fungal infection
6. Allergy to one of the study medications
7. Contraindication to fluoroquinolones:  a) hypersensitivity to ciprofloxacin, to other quinolones, or to any of  the following excipients (microcrystalline cellulose, crospovidone,  anhydrous colloidal silica, magnesium stearate, hypromellose,  macrogol, titanium dioxide), b) treatment with tizanidine,  c) previous hypersensitivity to any quinolone,  d) previous tendonitis attributed to any fluoroquinolone,  e) epilepsy
8. Contraindication to amoxicillin-clavulanate
9. QT prolongation (defined as a QT interval > 0.45 seconds for males  and > 0.47 seconds for females)
10. Antibiotic prophylaxis (with the exception of the combination  sulfamethoxazole and trimethoprim)
11. Pregnant or breastfeeding women
12. Patient deprived of liberty by judicial or administrative decision
13. Women of childbearing age not using contraception
14. Patient treated with anti-psychotic drug
15. Patient who is the investigator, any member of the study team, or a  relative directly involved in the trial, including assistant physicians,  pharmacists, study coordinators, etc…
16. Participation in another interventional clinical trial
17. Impossible collection of informed consent (including non-francophone  patient, or cognitive disorders)
18. Body mass index (BMI) > 30
19. Basal neutrophils count < 1000/mm3 (on the latest available blood test  performed < 1 month before inclusion)
20. Aminotransferase serum levels > 5 X normal values (on the latest  available blood test performed < 1 month before inclusion)
21. Creatinine clearance < 30 mL/min (on the latest available blood test  performed < 1 month before inclusion)
